reasonForUpdate.simplePara: EC-ARF-01: Modification M01 adds two quick-release latches. The fan assembly paragraph and the technical data changed.

levelledPara.title: General
levelledPara.para: The ARF-1 training rig is a bench-mounted device for maintenance training. It has an air recirculation fan, an air filter and a control box.
Students use the rig to practice removal, installation, examination, adjustment and fault isolation tasks. The rig does not represent a specific aircraft.

levelledPara.title: Main components
levelledPara.para: Refer to for the location of the components.

The rig has these main components:
The frame and the access panel
The fan assembly
The air filter
The airflow indicator
The control box

levelledPara.title: Fan assembly
levelledPara.para: The fan assembly pulls air through the air filter. Then it pushes the air through the outlet duct and the airflow indicator.
Before Modification M01, four screws and four washers attach the fan assembly to the frame.
After Modification M01, two quick-release latches attach the fan assembly to the frame. You do not need tools to open the latches.
A connector connects the fan assembly to the control box.

levelledPara.title: Air filter
levelledPara.para: The filter element is in the filter housing. A clamp holds the cover of the filter housing.
A differential pressure indicator is on the filter housing. When the filter element is blocked, the indicator shows a red band.

levelledPara.title: Control box
levelledPara.para:
The control box supplies electrical power to the fan assembly. It has these controls and indicators:
Power switch S1
Circuit breaker CB1
Speed control R1
POWER lamp DS1 (green)
FAN FAULT lamp DS2 (amber)
Test points TP1 and TP2
An adjustment potentiometer R2 inside the control box sets the maximum fan speed.

levelledPara.title: Technical data
levelledPara.para: The values in are training values for this fictional rig. Do not use them for other equipment.

entry.para: 24 V DC, from an external bench power supply
Fan speed signal at TP1 and TP2, speed control at MAX
Torque, fan mounting screws (before Modification M01)
